svg.title: The region inside r = 4 sin θ and outside r = 2
svg.desc: On a polar grid with circles of radius 1 to 4: the circle r = 4 sin θ in emerald, of diameter 4, sitting on the pole and reaching up to (0, 4), and the circle r = 2 in blue, centered at the pole. They cross at two marked points, at θ = π/6 and θ = 5π/6. The region inside r = 4 sin θ and outside r = 2, a crescent above the blue circle, is shaded.
